mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger is met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (> 0.5pp over 3 months) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE trigger is met but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS trigger is met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by > 10% y-o-y for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST trigger is met but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) rises above 60 for two consecutive months, it signals a rapid expansion in industrial activity that will lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO trigger is met but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (proxied by PAYEMS) grows by < 100k jobs for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS trigger is met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real retail sales (proxied by RSAFS) decline month-over-month for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS trigger is met but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.
